P1.F18.H1 provides the necessary frontend TypeScript and Zod schemas. P1.F23.H3 connects the frontend banner action. While P1.F12.H1 and P1.F8.H6 mention database locking, the implementation is not shown, so
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete database implementation, migration, or full test execution, and P1.F12.H1 lacks the actual locking implementation, preventing a tier 3 assessment. The tier is assigned based on the visible API and frontend implementation, not the unshown database transaction safety.
